newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks inch to higher pre-holiday close.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks inch to higher pre-holiday close.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks closed Tuesday's half-day session slightly up in active pre-holiday trade, with year-end demand for the market's leaders giving the index a small boost, brokers said.
"Investors are sticking with the winners today," said Anthony Mak, associate director at Vickers Ballas
The Hang Seng Index rose 10.13 points to end the half-day session at 13,341.61 after swinging through a 136-point range.
Turnover was a robust HK$4.75 billion compared to Monday morning's inflated HK$5.69 billion, which was boosted by two large share placements.
